request.initial_prompt: If only Estella had come to be a spectator of our proceedings, I should have felt sufficiently discontented; but as she brought with her the three ladies and the gentleman whom I had seen below, I didn't know what to do. In my politeness, I would have stopped; but Miss Havisham twitched my shoulder, and we posted on,—with a shame-faced consciousness on my part that they would think it was all my doing.

raw_segments.text: If only Estella had come to be a spectator of our proceedings, I should have felt sufficiently discontented.
But as she brought with her the three ladies and the gentleman whom I had seen below, I didn't know what to do.
In my politeness, I would have stopped, but Miss Havisham twitched my shoulder, and we posted on,—with a shame-faced consciousness on my part that they would think it was all my doing.
